title: League AC Embedded Trainee
description: Enrolled via Liga AC Labs program and was trained in the domain of embedded systems applied in automotive.
The program ended with a challenge which had the purpose to design a smart parking system.

Me and my team developed a miniature model of a parking spot and used the components given by the company to build a system that grants car access by scanning its plate and comparing with its attributes in a database.
The used components were: a raspberry pi, arduino, camera, piezo sensors, lcd display, steppers and a semaphore like pcb with 3 leds.

We designed a mobile app with a backend where the user signs in, register his/her cars and can reserve a spot with points acquired in the app via payment. The app keeps track of available spots and manages access in the parking spot.

For the core algorithm, the computer vision task: a photo is taken once the car triggers a sensor, it is pre-processed and a lite inference algorithm runs directly on the board to extract the plate number, which then is passed to a validator and corrector for romanian plates and then sent to the server which finds the associated user.
The rpi acts as the brains and the arduino is used for interfacing directly with sensors, actuators and displays.

title: Intern SWE AI Dev
description: I'm now a part of the sys debug team which works on the firmware that allows a VPU(which will be part of the new generation of Intel's processors) to function and communicate with other software.

It has various features for sorting/grouping/repairing tickets based on defined params and shortcuts for JIRA CRUD ops. It also uses a nlp model for analysis and feedback. PABLO was integrated in RegCtrl project.
